# allinkl_cronjob (Resource)

Manages a cronjob of the all-inkl.com (KAS) account. A KAS cronjob requests a URL on a schedule; it does not run a command.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "allinkl_cronjob" "nightly" {
  comment = "nightly import"
  url     = "example.com/cron.php"
  minute  = "30"
  hour    = "3"

  http_user     = "cron"
  http_password = var.cron_password
  mail_address  = "ops@example.com"
  mail_subject  = "comment"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `comment` (String) Free text describing the job. KAS requires one.
- `url` (String) Address to request without the protocol, e.g. `example.com/cron.php`.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the job runs.
- `day_of_month` (String) Day of month: `1-31` or `*`.
- `day_of_week` (String) Day of week: `0-7` or `*`; Sunday is `0` or `7`.
- `hour` (String) Hour: `0-23`, `*` or a step.
- `http_password` (String, Sensitive) HTTP basic auth password. Write-only: drift is not detectable. As with all Terraform secrets, the value is stored in the state file.
- `http_user` (String) HTTP basic auth user. Set `http_password` with it.
- `mail_address` (String) Address that receives the output of each run.
- `mail_condition` (String) No mail is sent when the output contains this word.
- `mail_subject` (String) `default`, or `comment` to use the comment as subject.
- `minute` (String) Minute: `0-59`, `*` or a step like `*/15`.
- `month` (String) Month: `1-12` or `*`.
- `protocol` (String) `https` (default) or `http`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) KAS-assigned id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import allinkl_cronjob.nightly 325208
```
